name: Gmail - Send Mail
description: gmail/send_mail action — sends an email via a connected Gmail account. Distinct from the generic 'email' provider. Requires Gmail connection (OAuth). Supports text or HTML email_type. Typically used in catch blocks to notify on errors.

input.subject: Error notification
input.body: An error occurred in the recipe.

_notes.provider_distinction: Use provider:'gmail' for Gmail-specific OAuth connector. Use provider:'email' for Workato's generic SMTP email action (different connector, different credentials).
_notes.email_type: 'text' for plain text, 'html' for HTML body — controls how the body string is rendered
_notes.catch_pattern: Commonly placed inside a catch block to send error alerts. Wire body to the catch error message pill: #{_dp('{"pill_type":"output","provider":"catch","line":"CATCH_AS","path":["message"]}')}
